webster.text: Partaking of the nature of the plague or other infectious disease; as a pestilential fever.

more.text: Producing or tending to produce infectious disease; as pestilential vapors.

example.quote: and as, on this account, there will be great reason to apprehend all the ill consequences of defective information, so, on account of the natural propensity of such bodies to party divisions, there will be no less reason to fear that the pestilential breath of faction may poison the fountains of justice.
